faqs.q: Where can I recycle different types of waste?
faqs.a: You can find locations for community recycling centres, household batteries, household chemical cleanout events, mobile phones, and Return and Earn collection points.

faqs.q: What is FOGO and how does it work?
faqs.a: FOGO is a kerbside collection service that allows food to be added to the green lid garden waste bin so it can be recycled into top quality compost.

faqs.q: When will local councils have to provide FOGO services?
faqs.a: Under new laws, local councils will have to provide all NSW households who receive a residual (red lid) waste collection service with a FOGO waste service by 1 July 2030.

faqs.q: Where can I find information on what goes into FOGO bins?
faqs.a: Information is available regarding what can go in household FO and FOGO bins.
